reviews.t: FANTASTIC! FAST ARRIVAL, PRO NAILS AT HOME - EASY TO LEARN
reviews.x: Wow!  Nice packaging, super easy to use, rock hard nails in about 10 minutes!  I experimented with different methods.  For me, the easiest method (after prepping nails and curing the base coat) is squeezing a small bead of product into the nail form, pushing around to spread evenly to form the nail, then pressing down near cuticle to remove bubbles. I'm a licensed cosmetologist who knows how to do acrylics...these are just as durable but WAY easier to remove..you can just take a nail tip and slide it under the false nail and pop it off..but i have yet to have one fall off on its own. Be careful when applying as the polygel needs to be fairly thin and when placing on the nail be sure not to smush it down as the polygel will squeeze out and go under your fingernails. definitely worth the self application

I swear I left my nails under for at least like 2-3 minutes each and they’re soft, they aren’t sticky but they’re soft and not nail like at all. Very disappointed in that.

claims.text: Many reviewers find the kit easy to use, especially for beginners doing their own nails.
Reviewers praise the value and completeness of the kit, noting it comes with lots of supplies and good-quality tools.
Some reviewers report durability problems, with nails breaking or staying soft shortly after application.
A few reviewers complain about the dual forms not fitting well or the product being inconvenient to use.
Some reviewers mention the removal process is messy and requires practice to get good results.

qa.q: Does this poly gel kit come with everything I need to get started?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on whether the kit includes everything needed: one reviewer says it's "everything and more" [2], while others note it lacks a UV light [3][4]. Some also found the dual forms didn't fit well and suggest buying a separate set [4][6].

claims.text: One reviewer describes the kit as "everything and more."
Other reviewers state there is no UV light included and you will need one.
Some reviewers found the dual forms didn't fit and suggest purchasing a separate set.

qa.q: How long does the gel last before lifting or chipping?
qa.answer: Not enough evidence in reviews to answer this.

qa.q: Is it easy to remove without damaging my nails?
qa.answer: Reviews disagree on removal ease: one reviewer says it's WAY easier to remove and can be popped off with a nail tip [1], while another found it STUCK on the first time but peeled off in one piece the second time, attributing the difference to nail prep [4]. No review directly addresses whether removal damages nails.
